name: spotnote-demo
description: The demo video, made with Remotion: a macOS desktop with a browser, a chat app and a terminal, all drawn in React.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.jsx Demo out/demo-2x.mp4 --scale=2 && remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/demo-2x.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/demo.mp4
